[ALERT] Windows Print Spooler and Print-Job Failures fired

Use case: UC-1.2.20 — Windows Print Spooler and Print-Job Failures

Severity tier: medium (investigative)

Investigate context and correlate with recent changes before escalation.

Alerts on either three or more Microsoft PrintService Event 372 print-job failures for the same host and printer during one closed five-minute window, or any Event 808 spooler plug-in load failure. It preserves native byte, page, client, module, error, record, and source context while explicitly treating each row as historical Admin-channel evidence rather than current queue or service state.
